A heterozygous germline nonsense or frameshift variant, almost always in the last exon (exon 8) of EPOR, truncates the cytoplasmic C-terminus of the erythropoietin receptor. The classic example is a G-to-A transition at nucleotide 6002 that converts a tryptophan codon to a stop codon, truncating the 70 C-terminal amino acids; frameshift insertions and deletions in the same region act similarly.

nodes.description: The raised red cell mass suppresses endogenous erythropoietin production through the normal oxygen-sensing feedback loop, which is itself intact.
